notes: No accepted C++ was collected (the one submission is RTE), so orig.cpp is a public solution (per-type fracturing heap of next-cheapest subsets, then a binary search on the K-th cost) with three bugs fixed: it read an empty group list when every type was fixed, the start plan counted even above the cost cap, and the search began at 1 so a free empty plan was never found; checked against the statement sample and a brute force over all subsets.
